description:
Aide Calendar is a calendar & task app for iPhone and iPad — now in ChatGPT.

Capture a plan in chat — type it, paste it, or show ChatGPT a screenshot — and it saves straight to Aide Calendar on your iPhone / iPad: event or task created, reminders set, synced across your devices. No retyping.

In ChatGPT
• Type or paste — "lunch Friday 1 pm at Nobu," "submit the report by Friday 5 pm"
• Upload a screenshot — a text, an email, an invite; ChatGPT reads it and saves it
• Saved complete — date, time, venue, attendees, phone, notes, and alerts
• Recurring and all-day events, and no duplicates when you re-save

On your iPhone & iPad — Aide Calendar
Everything you save here lives in the full Aide Calendar app, where you run your day:
• Capture on your phone too — screenshots, photos, voice notes, anything shared, in any language
• Five views (Day · 3-Day · Week · Week-list · Month), drag to reschedule, instant search
• A real task manager — priorities, due dates, Overdue / by day / Completed
• Tap a number to call, message, or WhatsApp; tap an address to open in Maps
• Real-time sync across iPhone and iPad

Private by design
• Saves only what you ask · never reads your other chats
• Keeps no copy of your events — they live only in your Aide account
• No ads, no tracking — Aide never uses your events to train AI models

Requires the Aide Calendar app for iPhone & iPad (iOS 17+)

defaultPrompt: Add dinner with Sarah this Friday at 7:30 pm and remind me an hour before.
Add all of these to my calendar: client call Monday 10 am, dentist Wednesday 3 pm, pay rent by Friday.
